_comment: The panel's words in every display language (display.language): the firmware's tables (Format.cpp) and the web interface's preview (www/index.html) are written from this file by tools/gen_texts.py -- edit here, then run it. Only letters the display's text font has (Latin, Greek, Cyrillic: tools/gen_texts.py checks). boot_device, boot_wifi, boot_address: 8 characters (16 bytes) at most. decimal, group: the separators of a number (1.234,5); date: the date format when display.date_format is not set, short enough for the home screen's field.
